title: About
text:
I am Dominique Strong, a Principal Business Analyst with 7+ years across healthcare and membership organizations. I turn data into decisions that improve customer experience, operational performance, and financial outcomes.
I have uncovered inefficiencies, optimized processes, and built predictive models that deliver measurable impact— including initiatives that safeguarded $3M+ in revenue and improved decision-making across dozens of business units.



Forecasting & Modeling: Machine Learning churn models for reliable retention planning

Dashboards & Storytelling: Tableau/Power BI for exec-ready insights

Operations & Data Analytics: Find defects, reduce leakage, and strengthen member trust
